changelog.summary: Backfilled difficulty on all 46 questions; fixed correct-field type on d3-013/014/015/016; stripped option letter prefixes
Enriched D1/D2/D3 notes: RAG vs fine-tune decision tree, Build/Buy/Extend callout, CoE section, licensing framework, and hard question patterns for all three domains

Fixed D1: merged duplicate Exam Traps sections, relocated orphaned security content into §1.9, repositioned misplaced §1.2b before §1.3. Fixed D3: removed orphaned duplicate Commitment-tiers table fragment. Added context-window definition, cross-domain quick-reference table, and D1→D3 licensing cross-reference.

D1 gap-fill: added 6 questions (ab731-d1-016..021) closing task 1.6 (previously zero questions — model selection + all 3 untested §1.9 security threats: prompt injection, data poisoning, model extraction), plus one more each for tasks 1.4 (RAG-vs-fine-tune decision framework) and 1.5 (agent vs RPA). Added the exam's first-ever scenario, ab731-scenario-001, spanning D1+D3.

Study-guide drift check (skills measured as of 2026-07-22): added 5 questions closing gaps — ab731-d1-022 (ML solution lifecycle/concept drift), ab731-d2-016 (proactive Graph/SharePoint governance ahead of rollout), ab731-d2-017 (automating multi-step business processes with Copilot Studio), ab731-d3-017 (three Copilot licence models incl. included-with-M365 tier), ab731-d3-018 (multinational privacy/data-residency compliance planning).

Added taxonomyIds to 3 domain(s) — cross-vertical relationship discovery metadata (IDEA-0008 Phase 4), aggregated + alias-resolved from each domain's own question tags. No question/notes/scenario content changed.

Notes freshness/drift refresh (no question-bank changes). Verified all 5 questions added in the 2026-09-01 drift check (v1.2.1) against notes coverage — d1-022, d3-017, d3-018 already taught (§1.1b, §3.7, §3.6b). Found and closed 2 genuine D2 gaps: added §2.15 (SharePoint Advanced Management / proactive oversharing governance before a Copilot rollout, closing ab731-d2-016) and §2.16 (Copilot Studio multi-step business-process automation/orchestration, closing ab731-d2-017). Re-checked the live skills-measured guide (still dated July 22, 2026 — no revision since the v1.2.1 check). Backfilled the Docs Engineer Deep Dive Standard, which none of the 3 domains had: added the required '## Deep Dive' section (connective narrative, worked scenario, memory aid, exam strategy) to D1, D2, and D3, plus a Human Angle callout to each domain's overview. Also fleshed out explanatory 'why it works this way' prose under 12 previously pointer-only topic sections across all 3 domains (D1 §1.1/§1.3/§1.4/§1.8/§1.9; D2 §2.1/§2.4/§2.10/§2.13; D3 §3.1/§3.2/§3.15) — mechanism-level reasoning, not new facts.
